name: Build a home
siteTitle: Build a Home | A Space to Reclaim Life Beyond Blue Screens
siteDescription: Help me find a home in Spain: a phone-free space for meditation, rest and presence. Support the project and get your attention back.

hero.eyebrow: A SPACE TO RECLAIM LIFE BEYOND BLUE SCREENS
hero.titleTwo: Step away from the endless scroll.
hero.subtitle: I'm looking for a house in Spain and I don't have the funds to buy it yet. My goal is to raise €40,000 to buy and renovate it. In return for your support, I'm offering the space I'll open there: a place to step back from the blue light, meditate, rest and be present.

services.title: Why this campaign
services.description: Screen overload is rarely talked about openly. For many people, compulsive use of the phone, social media or video games can interfere with rest, concentration, relationships and general wellbeing. I want to build a simple, welcoming place for people who want to step away from their screens and rediscover rest, real conversation and a sense of presence. Not a luxury retreat.

services.title: What the house will offer
services.description: A phone-free wellbeing space for adults. Guests will be asked to leave their phones aside during their stay and take part in a simple, structured programme centred on meditation, presence and healthier digital boundaries. Activities may include guided meditation, quiet time, walks, shared meals, group sessions, practical workshops on digital habits, and space to read, rest, talk and reconnect with others.

services.title: Use of funds
services.description: The goal is €40,000, to buy and renovate the house: finding and securing a suitable property in Spain, adapting and renovating it, furnishing it for the first programmes, and covering legal, administrative and notary costs.

services.title: Transparency & updates
services.description: Regular progress posts with photos, milestones and simple budget snapshots, so you can see every step.

services.title: Ways to help
services.description: Support the project if you can, or share the campaign with friends and communities. Sometimes the person who can help is just one share away.

legalNotice: This project offers wellbeing, meditation and presence activities. It does not provide diagnosis, psychological or psychiatric treatment, or professional mental-health care, and it is not a substitute for the support of a healthcare professional when needed. The house and its programmes are intended for adults aged 18 and over. Before their stay, each guest will be asked to accept the house rules, the commitment to leave their phone aside during activities, and the booking conditions. Phones will be stored away during the programme, while reasonable access will be available for emergencies and essential personal circumstances.

aboutpara:
Hi, I'm Patricia: a teacher, a creator, and someone who cares deeply about how our relationship with screens is shaping the way we live.

I teach English to international students and professionals, and I develop educational and creative projects.

I've seen, again and again, how many people struggle with a stressful, compulsive relationship with their screens, and a constant lack of attention.

I don't have the funds to buy a house on my own. So I'm asking for your help, and in return I'm offering what I'm building: a place to step back from the endless scroll, meditate, rest and be present.

I'll share transparent updates with photos and milestones along the way.

If you can't donate, sharing the campaign helps more than you might imagine.

Thank you for walking this path with me.
